question: How do full-utterance, centred two-second, and growing-prefix teacher targets affect the same delayed causal TCN?

full_utterance.interpolation: linear posterior interpolation on the 10 ms feature grid
full_utterance.window: whole clip; one posterior repeated over all frames

centred_2s.interpolation: linear posterior interpolation on the 10 ms feature grid
centred_2s.window: [target frame end - 1000 ms, target frame end + 1000 ms]

prefix_delta250.interpolation: linear posterior interpolation on the 10 ms feature grid
